_about: Published کارنامه-style rows (rank + subject percents). VERY LOW CONFIDENCE: undated private-consultancy pages that do not name a source; the Sharif rows also list general subjects that left the exam in 1402, so they are probably pre-1402 data under a new year label. Used only to place a model's percents next to published examples and to give a coarse rank RANGE, never a point rank. Percents copied as printed; column order of S11b inferred by the page layout.
